name: every-text-field-states-its-style
breaks: a text field goes back to inheriting AppKit's bezel, which is drawn inside whatever background the view specifies. Measured on this field: the app paints deepPage with an edgeRule border and the bezel covered it with a white rounded rect, which is the same defect that made the posting screen's tag fields render as near black pills while every colour they named was right (#919, #930, L231)
